# The budget rows a later census re-based above the pinned baseline in
# census-baseline-20261030.txt.
#
# The baseline derivation only lowers a budget: a caller a bead cuts keeps its
# baseline rate, tightened after a post-install census. A rate a later census
# measured higher is therefore an explicit override row in the budget table,
# not an edit to the pinned baseline, and the test that reads this file pins
# each override to the shipped table.
#
# Columns: calls per minute, caller, the bead that cut the caller.
#
# gt-1rub5: after gt-s0xpe cut the sling-context scan from 23 queries to one
# `bd query` per database, the census measured 14 calls a minute in the windows
# that listed it, 2026-11-01 14:00 to 14:03. Decision: overseer.
14.0	schedulerrun.listAllSlingContextRecords	gt-s0xpe
